new.content: Skip to content Home > Abhinav Patil: From Mechanical Engineering to Quality Analyst at XtrazCon—A Career Transformation Journey After 7 Years Abhinav Patil: From Mechanical Engineering to Quality Analyst at XtrazCon—A Career Transformation Journey After 7 Years Abhinav Patil’s journey shows how learning Software Testing classes in Pune can support a fresh career start, even after a career gap or a move from a different field. His journey from Mechanical Engineering to Quality Analyst at XtrazCon can give confidence to students and career changers who want to enter IT. Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 23, 2026 12:25 pm Abhinav Patil’s journey can help you understand that a different degree or a career gap does not mean you cannot start a new career. After completing his BE in Mechanical Engineering in 2019 , Abhinav decided to explore the IT field and learn Software Testing. He joined the Java-DST (Diploma in Software Testing) program at 3RI Technologies , taking his first step towards a completely new career path. After a 7-year career gap , starting again was a new challenge for Abhinav. But instead of letting the gap or his different background hold him back, he chose to learn, practice, and keep moving forward. His efforts helped him build his Software Testing skills and begin his new journey as a Quality Analyst at XtrazCon . His story is a simple reminder that a fresh start can lead to new opportunities when you are willing to take that first step. The Challenge For Abhinav, the main challenge was moving from Mechanical Engineering to Software Testing . Since his educational background was different from IT, he needed to understand a new field and develop the skills required for a testing role. The 7-year gap was another part of his career journey, as he wanted to restart his professional path and find a way to enter the IT industry. To make this change easier, Abhinav chose Software Testing classes in Pune , where he could learn the basics, clear his doubts, and slowly build the confidence needed to take his first step into the IT field. He wanted to start from the basics and understand the field step by step. That is why he joined the 5-month Java-DST (Diploma in Software Testing) program at 3RI Technologies . During the course, he learned Manual Testing, automation testing, and testing tools and got practical project experience. The course also helped him with resume preparation, mock interviews, interview practice, and placement assistance . This support helped Abhinav understand the field better and feel more ready for job interviews. Slowly, he became more comfortable with Software Testing and moved closer to starting his career in IT. The Software Testing Training Path Abhinav’s journey started with learning something completely new. Since his background was in Mechanical Engineering, he first needed to understand the basics of IT and Software Testing. At 3RI Technologies , he joined the 5-month Java-DST (Diploma in Software Testing) program , where he could learn step by step and slowly get comfortable with his new field. Month 1 – Starting from Zero: Abhinav started with the basic ideas of Software Testing and how software works. This helped him understand the field before moving to more technical topics. Month 2 – Understanding Testing: He learned about Manual Testing, different testing methods, and how testers find and report problems in software. Month 3 – Moving Towards Automation: Once the basics became clearer, he started learning Automation Testing and tools used for testing. This helped him understand how testing is done beyond manual work. Month 4 – Practice and Projects: Abhinav got more chances to practise what he had learned through practical work and projects. This helped him understand how testing concepts can be used in real situations. Month 5 – Getting Ready for Jobs: The final stage focused more on project work and interview preparation. Mock interviews, resume guidance, and Placement assistance helped him prepare for the next step in his job search. For Abhinav, this was more than just learning a course. He was learning a completely new field after a 7-year career gap and preparing himself for a different type of job. By taking it one step at a time, he became more comfortable with Software Testing and eventually started working as a Quality Analyst at XtrazCon . The Outcome of Software Testing Training in Pune The Software Testing training at 3RI Technologies gave Abhinav a chance to understand a completely new field and prepare for his move into IT. Coming from Mechanical Engineering, he learned the basics, practiced testing tasks, and gradually became more familiar with the work involved in Software Testing.The training also included practical learning, career guidance, interview preparation, and 3RI Technologies Placement to help Abhinav prepare for his IT career. What He Learned How It Helped Him Testing Concepts He got a clear idea of how Software Testing works and what a tester does. Practical Learning Working on practical tasks gave him a better understanding of how testing is done in actual projects. Technical Skills Learning testing tools and concepts gave him the knowledge needed to explore IT job opportunities. Career Preparation Interview practice and career guidance made him more prepared to face the job search. Career Transition Learning a new field gave him a way to move from Mechanical Engineering towards Software Testing. Career Outcome His efforts led to a new opportunity as a Quality Analyst at XtrazCon . Abhinav’s journey is not just about moving from Mechanical Engineering to IT. It is about giving yourself another chance to learn something new. After a 7-year career gap , he chose to start again, learn Software Testing, and work towards a new career. His experience shows that you do not always have to stay in the field you studied. With the right learning and a willingness to start again, a new career path can become possible. Take Action!
